text:
From what badly wounded wheatfield

did they go to lift you up,

my poor fallen angel?


Was it perhaps your destiny

to go so far away to end yourself,

and for that reason you were in such a hurry

when you departed?


Was the meeting in Castile,

and was that Castilian night

waiting for you at that hour

to receive you in its arms?


How unaware my life was

that your life was setting out

on a one-way journey

with no return and nothing more!...

translation.title: From What Badly Wounded Wheatfield?
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the elegy as a series of questions around a final one-way journey.
